content: Hyperbeam documents user-scoped roles and dynamically adding/removing roles, with control as a separable capability; Kasm sharing documents an initiator who retains control while participants observe by default, with sharing via a URL and participants able to see other viewers. For this app, host ownership must be real room authority rather than a display-name convention, grant/revoke should be explicit, and only the host/current controller may send input. Sources are product docs; features are contextual benchmarks, not a requirement to reproduce vendor auth.
